review_notes: I read the whole file. It has two unrelated proofs. The first is the clopen-basis transport along an open quotient map. The second is the restriction to a compact open subgroup, followed by a connected-component argument. They share no nontrivial reasoning. I grepped the formal-frontier sources for the key lemmas. The other uses of `totallySeparatedSpace_of_t0_of_basis_clopen` are in different contexts: a ring spectrum and a finite discrete characterization. Uses of `exists_compact_subset_nhds_one` in other files only obtain a compact open subgroup. I found no repeated block substantial enough to justify a shared lemma.
